title: iDISCO Protocol for Whole-Mount Immunostaining and Volume Imaging
author: Clara Huesing
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wzuff6w

steps.title: Clean workspace
steps.instruction: Thoroughly clean the work area before starting the procedure.

steps.title: Dehydrate samples
steps.instruction: Perform sequential MeOH/H₂O washes (20% MeOH/80% H₂O, 40% MeOH/60% H₂O, 60% MeOH/40% H₂O, 80% MeOH/20% H₂O, 100% MeOH, 100% MeOH), each for 1 hour on a rocker at room temperature. After the series, transfer samples into DCM‑safe glass vials.

steps.title: DCM/MeOH overnight incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples overnight with agitation on a rocker in 66% dichloromethane (DCM) / 33% methanol (MeOH) at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash in 100% MeOH
steps.instruction: Transfer samples to plastic tubes pre‑filled with 100% MeOH, then wash 2 × 15 min in fresh 100% MeOH on a rocker at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: First 15 min wash in 100% MeOH, rocker, RT
Second 15 min wash in 100% MeOH, rocker, RT

steps.title: H₂O₂/MeOH incubation
steps.instruction: Place samples in a 1:5 solution of 30% H₂O₂ in 100% MeOH and incubate overnight at 4 °C in a refrigerator.

steps.title: Rehydrate samples
steps.instruction: Remove the H₂O₂/MeOH mixture and rehydrate through a reverse MeOH/H₂O series (80% MeOH/20% H₂O, 60% MeOH/40% H₂O, 40% MeOH/60% H₂O, 20% MeOH/80% H₂O, 100% PBS), each for 1 hour on a rocker at room temperature.

steps.title: PBS overnight incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples in fresh PBS overnight on a rocker at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash in PTx.2
steps.instruction: Wash samples 2 × 1 hour in PTx.2 buffer on a rocker at room temperature, then proceed to immunolabeling.

substeps.instruction: First 1 h wash in PTx.2, rocker, RT
Second 1 h wash in PTx.2, rocker, RT

steps.title: Permeabilization
steps.instruction: Incubate samples at 37 °C in permeabilization solution on a rocker for 2 days.

steps.title: Blocking
steps.instruction: After removing permeabilization solution, incubate samples at 37 °C in blocking solution on a rocker for 2 days.

steps.title: Prepare primary antibody
steps.instruction: Mix the primary antibody with primary incubation solution; keep the mixture refrigerated at 4 °C while completing the next step.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Discard the blocking solution, transfer samples to fresh tubes, submerge them in the primary antibody mixture, and incubate on a rocker at room temperature for 1.5–2 weeks. Turn tubes on their side to ensure even exposure.

steps.title: Wash after primary
steps.instruction: Remove the primary antibody solution, then wash samples 5 × 1 hour in PTwH on a rocker at room temperature, followed by an overnight wash in fresh PTwH on a rocker at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Five 1 h washes in PTwH, rocker, RT
Overnight wash in fresh PTwH, rocker, RT

steps.title: Prepare secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Mix the secondary antibody with secondary incubation solution, then filter the mixture through a 0.22 µm filter using a 50 mL syringe.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Discard PTwH, add the filtered secondary antibody solution to the samples, cover the tubes with aluminum foil to prevent photobleaching, and incubate on a rocker at room temperature for 2 weeks. Turn tubes on their side for uniform exposure.

steps.title: Wash after secondary
steps.instruction: Remove the secondary antibody solution and wash samples 5 × 1 hour in PTwH on a rocker at room temperature, followed by an overnight wash in fresh PTwH on a rocker at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Five 1 h washes in PTwH, rocker, RT
Overnight wash in fresh PTwH, rocker, RT

steps.title: Second dehydration
steps.instruction: Dehydrate samples again through the MeOH/H₂O series (20% MeOH/80% H₂O, 40% MeOH/60% H₂O, 60% MeOH/40% H₂O, 80% MeOH/20% H₂O, 100% MeOH, 100% MeOH), each for 1 hour on a rocker at room temperature, then incubate in 100% MeOH overnight on a rocker at room temperature.

steps.title: Sandwich and DCM/MeOH incubation
steps.instruction: Prepare a 66% DCM / 33% MeOH mixture in glass jars. Place each sample between two glass slides, wrap wire around the sandwich (avoid flattening soft tissue), and secure it. Submerge the sandwich in the DCM/MeOH mixture, place on a rocker, and incubate for 3 hours at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Make 66% DCM / 33% MeOH mixture in glass jars
Press sample between slides, wrap wire to hold
Place sandwich in DCM/MeOH jar, rocker, RT

steps.title: Wash in 100% DCM
steps.instruction: After incubation, unwrap the wire with forceps, transfer each sample to a fresh glass jar containing 100% DCM, and wash 2 × 15 min on a rocker at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: First 15 min wash in 100% DCM, rocker, RT
Second 15 min wash in 100% DCM, rocker, RT

steps.title: Transfer to DBE
steps.instruction: While the DCM washes are running, fill clean glass jars to the top with dibenzyl ether (DBE). Immediately after the DCM washes, transfer samples to the DBE jars (the transfer is time‑sensitive because samples dry quickly once removed from DCM).

steps.title: Final workspace cleaning
steps.instruction: Thoroughly clean the workspace again. Note: after dehydration, samples can be stored short‑term (≈2 days) in 100% MeOH or, when hydrated, in PBS with azide. Clearing can be reversed if needed.
